resources.string: A row opens its post. Held, it shows its keys -- and a row held can be carried to another place in the queue.
Nothing on this blog sends the queue out by itself: no scheduled run has ever gone through it. A post whose time has come waits until it is published by hand -- hold its row.
The picture could not be read: it is most likely kept only in the cloud, and without a network it cannot be fetched. One that is on this device whole -- taken just now, say -- can be added.
